Laboratoires Gilbert
(part of Groupe Gilbert) is a French industrial group that manufactures and distributes a wide range of family health, cosmetic, and hygiene products.

Established in France in 1904
Groupe Gilbert
manages a portfolio of nearly 50 family health, hygiene, and cosmetic brands (including the flagship Laboratoires Gilbert brand) distributed in over 80 countries. The group manufactures its products across multiple specialized sites in France
and operates via an international network of local distribution partners and commercial business alliances rather than single corporate joint-ventures.

Core Product Brands
Physiodose:
Sterile saline solutions and baby hygiene
Marimer:
Natural seawater nasal hygiene sprays
Neutraderm:
High-tolerance dermocosmetics for sensitive skin
Physiolac:
Infant formula and baby nutrition
Luc et Léa:
Baby care accessories, pacifiers, and teething items
Le Comptoir Aroma:
Organic aromatherapy and essential oils
Parasidose & Moustidose:
Anti-lice treatments and mosquito repellents
Dolodent & Dologel:
Oral care and teething pain relief for infants
Algotherm & Laino:
Marine-based cosmetics and natural skincare lines
FYZIO:
Sports nutrition and specialized energy drinks

Manufacturing & Distribution Partnerships
Production Infrastructure:
Operates state-of-the-art GMP-certified manufacturing plants entirely based in France (such as in Normandy), serving as a major European contract developer and manufacturer (CDMO) for single-dose sterile units and sprays.
PharmaVenue
Commercial & Strategic Partners:
Collaborates regionally with international entities to handle localized import and regulatory distribution—such as AA Global Trading in the Middle East, Team Vitality as an official sports hydration partner, and operational distribution tracking links with institutional partners like Schiller France.
